entities.name: Extended CAG information list
entities.description: An information element that the network may include to assign a new CAG information list to the UE or delete the CAG information list at the UE side when the UE supports Extended CAG information list.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that supports Extended CAG information list capability.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that may include the Extended CAG information list IE in messages.

entities.name: CAG information list
entities.description: The list of Closed Access Group information stored at the UE that can be assigned or deleted via the Extended CAG information list IE.

relations.description: The network may include the Extended CAG information list IE in messages.
The Extended CAG information list IE is used to assign a new CAG information list to the UE or delete the existing CAG information list.
The inclusion of the Extended CAG information list IE is conditional on the UE supporting Extended CAG information list capability.
